QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_38

question.text: Under Regulation 17, within how many months must a merchant banker rectify deficiencies pointed out in the auditor's report?

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 17 requires every merchant banker, within two months from the date of the auditor's report, to take steps to rectify the deficiencies made out in that report. The Trap: The two-month period runs from the date of the auditor's report itself, not from the date the report is received. Other timelines (1, 3 or 6 months) apply to different compliance items. Note: Document the date of the auditor's report and the corrective actions taken so that the two-month window can be evidenced on examination.
